name: GPT-5 and o3 shut down on 11 Dec 2026; move to GPT-5.6
gain: Requests fail after 11 Dec 2026, which is under six weeks away. This is about working, not saving: the named successors cost more.
how: Follow the page per id: gpt-5 and o3 to gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5-mini to gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5-nano to gpt-5.6-luna, and gpt-5-pro and o3-pro to gpt-5.6-sol with reasoning.mode pro.
replaces: gpt-5, gpt-5-mini, gpt-5-nano, gpt-5-pro, o3, o3-pro and their dated snapshots
trade_offs: The successors cost more on OpenAI's own price list: gpt-5 is $1.25 / $10 and gpt-5.6-sol is $4 / $20 per 1M tokens.
A cheaper option may fit, such as gpt-6-sol at $2 / $10, but the page does not name it, so test before choosing.
needs: Nothing new; the same OpenAI key.
usage_signal: Usage API: calls on the affected model or parameter

gain_model.formula: no money figure: the call stops working or a capability is missing

verify_rule: The old id or parameter is gone and calls succeed over 7 days
